fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance at the SW corner off Transportation Circle - 2024 Street View (sv3) clearly shows chain-link security fencing with sliding gates across the truck lanes, bollards, and lane markings; the whole property is fully fenced.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A gray windowed guard booth stands in the truck lane at the SW gate (windows on multiple sides, ~1-vehicle footprint), with inbound and outbound lanes splitting around it - clearly visible in z20 satellite and 2024 Street View sv3. Staffed booth - remoteGs false.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved apron outside/before the gate at the SW entrance gives room for trucks to wait before the booth.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Vast paved yard inside the gate before the dock aprons - extensive internal queuing/holding for an LTL hub.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from the SW gate; easily holds 3+ trucks before the dock aprons.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron with multiple lanes and abundant unused paved width - room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single very long LTL cross-dock building with continuous dock doors on BOTH long faces - FedEx Freight's largest terminal in North America; FedEx Freight HGR is cited at ~278+ doors. Estimated ~290 - count approximate, flagged uncertain. 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer parking on both sides of the cross-dock building; hundreds of marked stalls, many holding parked trailers/dollies without tractors - dropYard true, 50+ band.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single SW gate handles both entry and exit, with the lanes splitting around the guard booth.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two FedEx buildings on the property - the main LTL cross-dock terminal/office and a separate truck-maintenance shop building at the SW (confirmed by web research describing a Terminal/Office building and a Truck Maintenance building).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Hagerstown MD - the site is on the edge of town in a highway-adjacent industrial setting with woods and open ground around it; judged Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 2 - main LTL cross-dock terminal plus truck-maintenance shop.
